requirements: R1: Modify JwtAuthenticationFilter.authenticateToken to throw an exception upon validation failure so the filter returns a 401 Unauthorized response.
R2: Remove the silent catch block in AuthController.ssoLogin that swallows BadCredentialsException.
R3: Reintegrate fetchOidcProfile into the ssoLogin error handling path to fulfill the autonomous LMS fallback requirement.
R4: Fix the underlying issue with fetchProfileWithToken that originally caused it to throw BadCredentialsException.

slices.title: Fix Auth Error Swallowing and Restore Fallback Flow
slices.jtbd: When implementing the fix for this epic, I want to ensure exceptions are thrown and handled rather than swallowed, so that the API correctly enforces authentication states and fallback paths.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an invalid JWT token is provided to the filter, When it is validated, Then an exception is thrown and caught to return a 401 Unauthorized response.
Given the SSO login process fails, When a BadCredentialsException is thrown, Then it must initiate the autonomous fallback data flow (fetchOidcProfile).
Given the changes are made, When integration tests are run against the auth flow, Then they must pass and verify 401 responses and fallback execution without mocking the exception handler.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Defect escape rate for auth error handling
